topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
response: L-DACS integration mitigates A2G communication saturation, providing secure and robust data services. It operates in L-band, using FDD (L-DACS1) or TDD (L-DACS2) techniques, ensuring efficient spectrum sharing. Metrics include 273 kb/s net user data rate and support for periodic A2A surveillance data transmission.
reference_context: L-DACS is designed to mitigate A2G communication saturation, operating in L-band with FDD or TDD techniques for secure data services.
